text_overlays.text: WORST STARTS A NEW PLAYER had with his club

was a center-back for Blackburn Rovers, fresh off playing for Ireland at Euro 2016. He was one of their most promising defenders, the kind of player Celtic and Premier League clubs were watching, but then over just a few days in August, his whole season unraveled. It started on a Saturday at Wigan, where in the 63rd minute, Duffy turned the ball into his own net and Blackburn lost three to nothing. The abuse online got so heavy that he deleted his personal Twitter account that very night. But that own goal would end up being the least of his problems. The following Wednesday, Blackburn traveled to Cardiff, and in the 14th minute, a shot smacked the post and Duffy accidentally stroked the rebound into his own empty net. Six minutes after that, a free kick floated in and he powered a header past his own keeper. Then deep in stoppage time, while chasing an equalizer, he kicked the ball away in frustration, picked up a second yellow, and got sent off. But the strangest part wasn't the red card or the own goals. And if you're enjoying the video please hit the follow button. Duffy had now beaten his own goalkeeper, Jason Steele, three times in under an hour of football, and that freak run made him the joint top scorer in the entire Championship. Cardiff's own fans gave him a standing ovation as he walked off.

ending.last_frame: Duffy walking off the pitch with Cardiff fans applauding in the background.
